description.en: Diesel Engine Codes Sit Beside the Kilowatts. 56 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Compressor.
description.zh: 柴油机代号怎样和千瓦印在一起。56 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「压缩机」。

h1.en: Compressor illustrates the note on Diesel Engine Codes Sit Beside the Kilowatts
h1.zh: 「压缩机」用来说明柴油机代号怎样和千瓦印在一起

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a diesel code and a kilowatt figure together on several concrete pumps in Xingtai. Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的多台混凝土泵上把柴油机代号和千瓦标出在一起。柴油40和柴油搅拌泵使用 4108，分别是 66 kW 和 66–75 kW。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor. The image subject is Compressor. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists a diesel code and a kilowatt figure together on several concrete pumps in Xingtai. The sheet does not explain the digits. 6105 on Diesel 60 is 144 kW. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a further engine specification under the code. The tractor page lists power 40 kW with no diesel code. If a buyer needs an engine plate detail that is not in the entry, the route is /en/contact/.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor。画面内容是Compressor。河北品锦机械在邢台的多台混凝土泵上把柴油机代号和千瓦标出在一起。LZ-60 上的 6105 是 145 kW。拖拉机页标出功率 40 kW，没有柴油机代号。

body.en: Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW. LZ-80 and Diesel 120 do not use these codes. 6105 on LZ-60 is 145 kW. Diesel 120 lists 290 kW (two units 145 kW) and does not list 4105, 4108 or 6105. Do not invent a 4105 label for those pages.
body.zh: 柴油40和柴油搅拌泵使用 4108，分别是 66 kW 和 66–75 kW。柴油40的 4108 是 66 kW，柴油搅拌泵标出的是 4108 / 66–75 kW。目录没有说 4105 代表缸数、排量，或写出文字以外的品牌。

body.en: Diesel 40 and the diesel mixer list 4108, at 66 kW and at 66–75 kW. Read the code and the kilowatts as one entry. The shared code is not shared power. LZ-80 lists 256 kW (Yuchai). The catalogue does not say that 4105 means a cylinder count, a displacement or a brand beyond the characters shown.
body.zh: 柴油50、柴油60和 LZ-60 都标出 6105，分别为 99 kW、144 kW 和 145 kW。河北品锦机械没有在代号下面再公布一份发动机细规格。如果买方需要格子里没有的发动机铭牌细节，途径是 /zh/contact/。

body.en: Diesel 50, Diesel 60 and LZ-60 all list 6105, at 99 kW, 144 kW and 145 kW. 6105 on Diesel 50 is 99 kW. 4108 on Diesel 40 is 66 kW, while the diesel mixer lists 4108 / 66–75 kW. The rural diesel pump lists 17 kW with no code. Yuchai is named only on LZ-80.

question.en: On this row: Does 6105 always mean 99 kW?

answer.en: No. Diesel 50 lists 99 kW, Diesel 60 lists 144 kW and LZ-60 lists 145 kW, all beside 6105. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor.
answer.zh: 不是。柴油50标出 99 kW，柴油60标出 144 kW，LZ-60 标出 145 kW，旁边都是 6105。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Which page names Yuchai?

answer.en: LZ-80. The entry reads 256 kW (Yuchai). It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor.
answer.zh: LZ-80。这一格写的是 256 kW（玉柴）。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. It lists diesel engine power 17 kW and no engine code. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor.
answer.zh: 不标出。它标出柴油机功率 17 kW，没有发动机代号。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is the code explained on the sheet?
question.zh: 参数页解释这个代号吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the code and the kilowatts only. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械只标出代号和千瓦。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Compressor画面里印出的数字。
